arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Stewart stated the opposing side was convicted of a misdemeanor drug offense.
Ms. Fox argued the government failed to establish effective consent to search.
Ms. Fox noted that detecting drug abuse may dispense with individualized suspicion.
Mr. Stewart cited California having over 67,000 police officers and 7,000 probation officers.

paragraphs: This case defines the scope of police authority over probationers. It determines whether individualized suspicion is required for warrantless searches. The outcome impacts the balance between public safety and privacy rights.
